#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>

typedef long long LL;

LL puteri[20];

{
    LL contor = number / puteri[pos];
    if (number % puteri[pos] == 0)
        return static_cast<int>(pos * contor);
    int a = pos * contor + solve(number % puteri[pos], pos - 1);
    int b = pos * (contor + 1) + solve(puteri[pos] - (number % puteri[pos]), pos - 1);

    scanf("%lld", &n);

    printf("%d\n", result);
